Metadata.title: Sajjad Mohammadi Nejad — Senior Backend Architect
Metadata.description: Senior Backend Developer building AI-native, scalable systems with NestJS, Go, and modern distributed architectures. Consulting, design, and hands-on courses.

Hero.badge: Senior Backend Architect · AI & Distributed Systems
Hero.subtitle: I help companies enter the market through internet products, design scalable platforms, and teach modern backend engineering with NestJS and Go.

About.title: About me
About.lead: Senior Backend Developer with over 15 years of experience building robust, scalable systems with Node.js, NestJS, and Go. I work on microservice architectures, performance optimization with Redis, and modern inter-service communication using RabbitMQ and gRPC, with deep exposure to AI integrations (Ollama, OpenAI), Web3, and CI/CD automation.

architecture.title: Systems thinking
architecture.body: From monoliths to microservices, I design for the constraints that matter: latency, consistency, and team velocity.

ai.title: AI-native engineering
ai.body: LLM assistants, forecasting engines, and automation pipelines woven directly into the product fabric.

teaching.title: Knowledge compounding
teaching.body: I teach what I build so teams become self-sufficient — clean code, TDD, and well-documented systems.

Services.title: What I can do for you
Services.subtitle: End-to-end partnership: from market entry strategy to production-grade delivery and training.

consulting.title: Market entry consulting
consulting.body: Strategy for entering the market through internet products — competitive analysis, architecture decisions, and a pragmatic roadmap.

web.title: Web & app design
web.body: Scalable, modern web and mobile applications designed and engineered with NestJS, Go, and React.

training.title: Backend training
training.body: Hands-on NestJS and Go courses that take engineers from fundamentals to production microservices.

ai.title: AI & automation
ai.body: LLM-powered assistants, forecasting systems, and process automation with Ollama and OpenAI.

devops.title: DevOps & CI/CD
devops.body: Docker, GitHub Actions, and GitLab CI pipelines that make shipping boring and safe.

review.title: Architecture review
review.body: Code review, security audits, and performance tuning for existing Node.js and Go systems.
